captions.formal: A high-angle, time-lapse shot captures vehicular traffic moving through a multi-lane city intersection during daylight. Numerous cars in various colors, including white, silver, red, and orange, travel along the asphalt road, with some appearing blurred due to motion. The street is lined with trees featuring yellow autumn foliage and several tall, white residential apartment buildings in the background. A building on the left displays the text KOREA ILLIES ENGINEERING. The scene is illuminated by bright, natural light, casting soft shadows across the roadway and urban landscape.
captions.sarcastic: A breathtaking display of urban efficiency unfolds as a collection of cars engages in a high-stakes game of musical chairs on a multi-lane road. The yellow autumn trees provide a lovely, organic contrast to the grey concrete monoliths and the thrill of sitting completely still in traffic. We get to admire a red bus and various white and orange sedans as they bravely battle the concept of forward momentum. It is truly an inspiring vista of a city that clearly loves its idling engines.
captions.humorous_tech: The city's traffic flow is currently experiencing a major production incident, with latency peaking as vehicles enter a massive bottleneck. We see white and orange cars attempting to deploy themselves toward the horizon, but they are clearly hitting a rate limit on the asphalt. It looks like a classic merge conflict between the main arterial road and the side streets, leaving the red bus stuck in a perpetual loading state. Someone needs to roll back these urban planning changes before the entire system crashes.
captions.humorous_non_tech: we have a lovely parade of cars that have all decided they simply aren't in any rush to get home. The yellow trees are standing there like cheering fans, watching the white and orange cars play a very slow game of follow-the-leader. A big red bus joins in, probably wondering if it's too late to just call it a day and take a nap. It is the kind of afternoon where the only thing moving faster than the traffic is a snail with a little bit of motivation.

captions.formal: A small, long-haired orange kitten walks forward through a wooded area. The kitten emerges from beneath green foliage and thin brown branches, moving across a dirt ground shaded by a canopy of leaves. It maintains a steady forward gaze toward the camera as it advances. The setting consists of a dirt path bordered by dense green shrubs and the textured bark of a large tree trunk on the left. Natural light filters through the leaves, creating dappled shadows across the terrain.
captions.sarcastic: A truly terrifying apex predator has emerged from the underbrush. This fluff-covered orange kitten manages to walk forward a few inches while maintaining a look of profound confusion, as if it has forgotten why it left the bushes. It navigates the treacherous terrain of some dirt and a few twigs with all the grace of a stumbling toddler. One can only imagine the absolute chaos it intends to wreak upon the world once it figures out how its own paws work.
captions.humorous_tech: A small orange kitten is attempting to deploy into the open field, but it looks like the process is hanging at 20%. It steps forward tentatively through the greenery and dirt, exhibiting the kind of high latency you'd expect from a legacy system running on a dial-up connection. The kitten's wide-eyed expression suggests it has just encountered a critical runtime error in the middle of a production environment. It's not a walk; it's a slow-motion debugging session of its own motor skills.
captions.humorous_non_tech: We have a tiny orange kitten who thinks he is a fierce jungle tiger, despite being roughly the size of a potato. He creeps out from behind some green leaves and thin brown branches, taking very slow, very serious steps across the dirt. He has that look of intense concentration you only see on people trying to remember if they locked the front door. He is clearly on a high-stakes mission to find a nap, but the dirt is just too exciting.

captions.formal: A woman with dark hair styled in a high bun sits at a white desk in an office environment. She wears a beige button-down shirt over an orange top and a necklace with a cross pendant. The subject is positioned in front of a silver computer monitor, using a white keyboard and a black mouse. She looks at the screen with a focused expression, blinking and shifting her gaze while typing. The background contains black office partitions, a green potted plant in a white pot, and overhead circular lighting.
captions.sarcastic: A woman showcases the peak of professional fulfillment while staring at a monitor in a sterile office. Wearing a beige jacket over an orange top, she offers the screen a look of profound bewilderment, as if the computer has just explained a joke she doesn't find funny. She types a few keys with her pink nails, clearly engaged in a high-stakes battle with a spreadsheet or a particularly stubborn email. The presence of a single potted plant in the background really ties the whole corporate wasteland together. It is truly an inspiring display of modern productivity.
captions.humorous_tech: A woman in a beige jacket and orange top is currently experiencing a real-time production incident. Sitting at a white desk with a black mouse and keyboard, she stares at her monitor with the exact expression of a developer who just realized the bug is in the legacy code they wrote six months ago. She tentatively types a few keys, likely attempting a hotfix that she knows, deep down, will probably break three other unrelated dependencies. Her facial expression is the human embodiment of a 500 Internal Server Error, perfectly capturing the moment the deploy goes south.
captions.humorous_non_tech: A woman is having a very serious disagreement with her desk equipment. Dressed in a beige jacket and orange shirt, she looks at the monitor with a face that says, 'I know you're lying to me.' She taps a few keys with her pink nails, trying to be polite, but her wide eyes suggest she's just seen something that makes absolutely no sense. Beside her, a green plant watches in silence, probably wondering why humans spend all day staring at glowing boxes. It is a classic tale of a person versus a machine, and the machine is winning.
